title: Student Transportation Services Business Office Calculation: The Cancellation Credit on a Courtesy Rider Permit
content:
**Definition.** The cancellation credit on a Student Transportation Services courtesy rider permit is the permit fee net of every meal-status waiver credit, household cap credit and billing correction credit against it, times the credited share of the permit period, never below zero and never more than one, then less the processing charge of 10.00 USD, never below zero, rounded half-up to the cent once on the result.

**Credited share.** The calendar days from the last day of service to the last day of the permit period, divided by the calendar days of the fee's span.

## Figures of the permit period

| Permit | First school day | Last day | Months |
|---|---|---|---|
| school-year permit | August 12, 2026 | May 31, 2027 | 10 |
| fall semester permit | August 12, 2026 | December 31, 2026 | 5 |
| spring semester permit | January 6, 2027 | May 31, 2027 | 5 |

- **Months the fee covers.** All the months of the permit period for a fee posted before the permit period's first school day. For a school-year fee posted on or after that day, the whole calendar months from the month the fee posted through May, that month included. For any other fee posted on or after that day, the calendar days from the posting day to the period's last day, divided by the calendar days from the period's first school day to its last day, times the months of the permit period.
- **Fee's span.** From the later of the period's first school day and the posting day, to the period's last day.
- **Counting days.** A count of calendar days from one date to another is the number of days by which the later date follows the earlier.

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

A fall semester fee of 120.00 USD posted on July 20 carries a reduced-price waiver credit of 60.00. The parent confirms the cancellation on October 21.

| Step of the definition | Figure |
|---|---|
| fee net of waiver, cap and billing correction credits | 120.00 less 60.00: 60.00 |
| fee's span | August 12 to December 31: 141 days |
| credited share | 71 days (October 21 to December 31) divided by 141: 0.503546 |
| net fee times the credited share | 30.2128 |
| less the processing charge | 30.2128 less 10.00: 20.2128 |
| rounded half-up to the cent | 20.21 USD |

## Points of judgement

- **A credit that figures below zero** is zero and posts no credit entry.
- **Credits counted against the fee** are the meal-status waiver, household cap and billing correction credits.
